document_name: Double J Stent — Clinical Evaluation Report

findings.violating_statement: Post-market surveillance data not included in this report.
findings.explanation: MDR requires a PMS system whose data feed the clinical evaluation; its absence is a gap.
findings.suggested_correction: Add a PMS section summarising complaints, CAPAs and PMCF findings per Articles 83-86.

findings.guideline_clause: MDR Annex XIV Part A — Clinical evaluation plan
findings.explanation: Equivalence must be fully documented or a clinical investigation conducted for this device class.
findings.suggested_correction: Provide a complete technical/biological/clinical equivalence demonstration or justify the gap.

findings.guideline_clause: MDR Annex II — Technical documentation (date control)
findings.explanation: Document-control dates should be consistent and not post-dated relative to issue.
findings.suggested_correction: Verify the revision date matches the approval workflow and correct any inconsistency.
